name: W1 Short — Post-Sweep Continuation
review_reason: Look-ahead bias discovered 2026-04-29. The htf_fvg_15m_swept='in_session' label that defines this cohort was set by intraday-tagged 15m FVGs (available_time='10:00') leaking into the candidate set for trades entering before 10:00. 51 of 55 'verified' trades had their sweep label triggered by an intraday FVG that wasn't a defined structure at entry time. Bug fix in enrich_trades_with_levels.py:286 (passes_time_gate now enforced on HTF FVG loop). With the fix, legitimate cohort drops from 55 trades (94.5% WR) to 4 trades (50% WR, 2W/2L) — sample too small to claim edge.
broader_audit: Across 1572 enriched trades: 221 had cached 'in_session', 101 (46%) were look-ahead bias triggered by intraday FVGs.

setup.gate: htf_fvg_15m_swept == 'in_session' — the nearest unswept bullish 15m FVG below entry has ALREADY been touched by price between 9:30 and your entry timestamp
setup.narrative: The 15m FVG below acts as a magnet/reaction zone. When price taps it before your entry, the reactive zone is consumed. Your entry then has clean path down with no near-term bounce point. Sequence: 9:30 RTH opens → price dips into 15m FVG below (the liquidity grab) → price retraces up → FVGC short fires on the bounce → you enter → price runs freely (median MFE 8.4R).

action_plan: 1) Confirm W1 short trigger (FVGC short 9:30-9:45). 2) Pull up 15m chart, identify nearest unswept bullish 15m FVG below current price. 3) Has price touched it between 9:30 and now? If YES → take with full size + extended target. If NO → fall back to standard W1 confluence model. 4) BE@1R then ride for 3R+, aggressive trail for 5R+.
caveats: Sample n=55 robust over 30 months but smaller than parent W1 play. Forward-track for OOS validation.
Confluence count and sweep state are correlated (more bearish setup = price moves faster = more likely to sweep before entry). 37% of 4+ conf trades have in_session sweep vs 8% at 0-1 conf.
Sweep label uses 30s bars from 9:30 → entry timestamp inclusive only — no look-ahead bias confirmed in data/levels/enrich_trades_with_levels.py.

description: After 9:45, take 1m FVGCs pointing at an OR side that has NOT been swept yet. Target 2R, hold original SL. The OR is a magnet — 95% of days one side gets tested by 10:15. The play captures the move toward whichever side is still untouched. Kill switches: OR > 150pt | variant = ifvg | both OR sides already swept | direction toward already-swept side. 8yr validated: n=543, PF 1.93, OOS PF 1.78, EV +0.43R/trade. Bootstrap 95% CI on PF [1.47, 2.21]. The old 'play dies on any sweep' rule was over-strict — play is only dead when BOTH sides are swept.
action_plan: At 9:45 ET: mark OR.H and OR.L. If OR range > 150pt -> NO PLAY today. From 9:45-10:15, watch 1m bars. On each FVGC: (1) variant != ifvg, (2) direction points at unswept OR side, (3) at least one OR side still unswept -> TAKE IT at flat size. Take every qualifying fire (same-day re-entries are stronger). Target 2R, hold original SL, NEVER move to BE. Day's done when both OR sides swept OR 10:15 ET.

volume_profile_setup.what_is_it: Volume Profile shows how much volume traded at each price level during a session. It builds a horizontal histogram on your chart. POC (Point of Control) is the price with the most volume. VAH (Value Area High) and VAL (Value Area Low) mark the range containing 70% of the session's volume.
tradingview_setup: Open NQ futures chart, any timeframe (1m or 5m recommended for intraday)
Click Indicators (top toolbar) > search 'Fixed Range Volume Profile'
Draw from prior day's RTH open (9:30 ET) to prior day's RTH close (16:00 ET)
Settings > Style: set Value Area to 70%, check 'Show POC', 'Show VA High/Low'
Alternatively: Indicators > search 'Session Volume Profile' > set session to 'Regular' to auto-draw daily VP
The POC line, VAH line, and VAL line will extend into the current session — these are your levels
tradezella_setup: Tradezella does not have a built-in volume profile indicator
Use TradingView for the VP overlay during live trading, then log the trade in Tradezella
In Tradezella: tag Thursday + Inside VA trades with a custom tag (e.g. 'thu_va_play')
Add a custom field or note: 'Prior day POC: ___  VAH: ___  VAL: ___' for tracking
Filter your journal by this tag to track performance of this specific play over time

description: On Thursdays, when the FVGC entry price falls inside the prior day's Value Area (between VAL and VAH), the model produces 73.7% WR and 2.89 PF. Works both long and short. The edge comes from the Thursday + VA interaction — neither factor is significant alone. Thursdays see institutional rebalancing ahead of Friday expiration; inside the VA signals acceptance/balance, so FVGC entries catch mean-reversion rotations that resolve cleanly.
action_plan: Night before (Wednesday): pull up prior day's volume profile on TradingView. Note VAH and VAL prices. On Thursday morning: if a FVGC entry forms and the entry price is between VAL and VAH, take it (long or short). Target 1R baseline, extend to 2R if bearish 930 candle or normal VIXY. SL per model rules (median SL ~30 pts). All macro windows MW1-MW3 are valid (MW2 is strongest at 79% WR).

name: Small-Gap Fade Long (9:31 Entry, Half-Gap Target, Gap>=25pts)

kill_switch.shorts: Gap-up symmetric short cell does NOT clear WR>=65/PF>=2. Longs only.
kill_switch.gap_atr_high: Skip if gap_atr_ratio >= 0.6 — medium/large gaps don't resolve in 45 min.
kill_switch.gap_too_small: Skip if |gap| < 25 NQ points. Tiny gaps are pure noise: bucket analysis showed gap<20pts gave 28% WR / mean -0.73R. This is the most important filter.
kill_switch.open_outside_range: Skip if 9:31 open is not strictly between prior-day RTH low and high.
kill_switch.930_bearish_or_doji: Skip if 9:30 candle isn't bullish (close > open). No trade.

context_notes.entry_timing: Entry at 9:31:00 open — AFTER the 9:30 1-minute candle has closed. Earlier backtest with 9:30:00 entry had lookahead.
context_notes.pf_metric_note: PF(pts)=3.61x is raw point PnL ratio. PF(R)=2.53x is risk-adjusted (each trade normalized to 1R = 1.5x gap). Both clear 2.0 full-period. IS PF(R) is 1.80x (below 2.0 threshold) — the strategy's edge is real but not exceptional in-sample.
context_notes.gap_floor_rationale: The |gap| >= 25pts floor was derived from bucket analysis: gap<20pts gave 28% WR / -0.73R (pure noise), gap 20-40pts gave 76% WR / +0.02R, gap 40-80pts gave 83% WR / +0.19R. The cliff between 10-20pts and 20+pts is a structural boundary (noise vs real institutional positioning), not a fine-tuned parameter.
context_notes.inverted_rr: R:R is 0.33:1 (TP 0.5*gap vs SL 1.5*gap). Requires WR > 75% just to breakeven per R. 80% WR IS is real but leaves thin margin — a 4-loss streak takes back ~1 year of wins. Mentally hard to trade.
context_notes.oos_caveat: OOS (2025-06-01+, n=13) shows 84.6% WR / PF(R) 35x — strong, but n=13 is too small. 95% CI on 84.6%/n=13 is roughly [55%, 98%]. Anchor live expectations to IS (n=33, WR 78.8%, PF(R) 1.80, Mean R +0.11).
context_notes.v4_alternative: V4 full_trail variant (full unit, 50%-of-MFE trail after MFE>=1R) had higher expectancy (+0.339R/trade vs +0.159R) and higher PF(R) 2.60x, but lower WR (67.4%) and 1.57x IS PF(R). More expensive to execute (wider exits on trail), but captures tail days. See results/v3_V4_full_trail_trades.csv.

validation.lookahead_check: Entry at 9:31:00 (after 9:30 candle closes) eliminates lookahead on candle_930_aligned filter.
validation.filter_derivation: Baseline (gap>=2pts) had PF(R)=0.77 — under-water in risk-adjusted terms. Gap-size bucket analysis revealed noise/signal cliff at 20pts. Promoting gap>=25pts as the operational floor.

description: Gap-down NQ >= 25pts opens inside prior-day RTH range, small relative to ATR (|gap|/14d-ATR < 0.6). If the 9:30 1-min candle closes bullish (buyers stepped in after open), enter long at 9:31:00 open and fade to 50% of the gap. Stop 1.5x gap, time-stop 10:45. ~1-2 trades/month. 80.4% WR / PF(pts) 3.61 / PF(R) 2.53 full-period (30s TF, 2023-10 -> 2026-03). IS PF(R) 1.80 is the honest conservative estimate. Lookahead-checked, IS/OOS split, gap-floor derived from bucket analysis.
action_plan: Pre-market: note prior-day RTH high / low / close. At 9:30 open: compute gap = open - PDC. If |gap| < 25 NQ pts, SKIP (this is the key filter — no exceptions). If gap >= 0 (gap-up), skip. If open outside prior-day range, skip. Compute 14d ATR of prior-day RTH range; if |gap|/ATR >= 0.6, skip. Watch the 9:30 1-min candle. At 9:30:59 if it closed bullish (close > open), enter long at 9:31:00 open. TP = entry + 0.5*|gap|. SL = entry - 1.5*|gap|. Time-stop at 10:45 (close remaining at market).
